about: Success criteria for Module 17, written on 2026-10-17 BEFORE any model was fine-tuned. Lab 17-3 locks this file (hash + time); Lab 17-7 refuses to grade against criteria that changed after training started. Moving the goalposts after you see the results is the most common way a fine-tune 'succeeds'.
held_out: test (48 hand-written) + m16 (Module 16's 18) = 66 tickets, never trained on
baseline: laya_router for Laya candidates, gliner_base for GLiNER candidates (the zero-shot model you would otherwise ship)

criteria.what: queue accuracy on held-out beats the baseline by at least 10 points
the gain is not luck: exact McNemar p-value on held-out below 0.05
every dangerous ticket in held-out is flagged (safety recall 100 %)
Thai queue accuracy within 10 points of English
breaks at most 2 tickets the baseline got right
general skill kept: forgetting-probe accuracy drops by at most 2 of 12
median latency at most 1.5 × the baseline's
